disclaimer: 预约与购票口径为公开信息整理，逐景点实测状态以 verified 字段标注；未实测条目上线前必须复核。

title.en: Great Wall, old capitals & the central axis

desc.en: A day on Beijing's central axis says more than any documentary.
desc.zh: 北京中轴线上的一天，比任何纪录片都更直白。

note.en: Real-name booking required. Passport holders can book online at most sites, but a few still need counter verification.
note.zh: 需实名预约。多数景点持护照可线上预订，少数仍需到窗口核验。

desc.en: Suzhou's windows, Hangzhou's lake, Wuzhen's bridges. It only works slow.
desc.zh: 苏州的窗、杭州的湖、乌镇的桥，节奏慢下来才好看。

note.en: Popular gardens cap daily entries; book 3–7 days ahead in peak season.
note.zh: 热门园林有每日限流，旺季建议提前 3–7 天预订。

desc.en: Zhangjiajie's peaks, Jiuzhaigou's water, Guilin's river. Give this line time.
desc.zh: 张家界的峰、九寨沟的水、桂林的江——这一线要留够时间。

note.en: Timed-entry tickets; passport number accepted at checkout on official channels.
note.zh: 分时段入园，官方渠道下单时可用护照号。

desc.en: Shanghai, Shenzhen, Guangzhou: easiest on English, easiest first stop.
desc.zh: 上海、深圳、广州：英文最够用，也最容易上手的第一站。

note.en: Most attractions take walk-ups; observation decks are worth pre-booking.
note.zh: 多数景点可现场购票；观景台类建议提前订。

title.en: Worth a trip for the food alone

desc.en: Chengdu, Xi'an, Guangzhou. Menus are Chinese-only — which is exactly where AI earns its keep.
desc.zh: 成都、西安、广州。菜单大多只有中文——这恰好是最值得用 AI 的地方。

note.en: Restaurants mostly don't take reservations for small parties.
note.zh: 小桌一般不接受预订，现场排队为主。

desc.en: Spring Festival lanterns, March cherry blossom, late-autumn ginkgo. Same route, different season, different trip.
desc.zh: 春节灯会、三月樱花、深秋银杏。同一条线，换个时间完全不同。

note.en: Peak-date slots sell out weeks ahead; check the exact bloom or festival window first.
note.zh: 高峰日期的名额常提前数周售罄，先确认花期或节庆窗口。

desc.en: Cherry blossom, mild, crowds picking up
The two universally agreed best windows
Late autumn, fewer people, lower prices

months.en: Spring Festival / May Day / National Day
months.zh: 春节 / 五一 / 国庆

desc.en: Domestic travel peaks — tickets and crowds max out
desc.zh: 国内出行高峰，票价与景区人流到顶
